name: Schlegeis-Staumauer & Stausee
kurzbeschreibung: The Schlegeis-Staumauer dam at 1,782 m in upper Zillertal: 131 m high arch dam, dam interior tours, Flying Fox, and the '#Schlegeis131' via ferrata.
beschreibung:
Overview

The gigantic Schlegeis-Staumauer and the turquoise-blue reservoir lake Schlegeisspeicher are situated in the high-alpine Schlegeisgrund within the Zillertaler Alpen at an altitude of 1,782 metres in the municipality of Finkenberg/Ginzling (Schwaz district). Set against a monumental mountain panorama between glaciated 3,000-metre peaks including the Olperer (3,476 m) and the Hochfeiler (3,510 m), this immense hydroelectric facility operated by VERBUND AG is one of Tyrol's most awe-inspiring mountain attractions. With a dam height of 131 metres and a crest length of 725 metres, this mighty double-curvature concrete arch dam impounds over 126 million cubic metres of alpine water.

Route & Requirements

Constructed between 1965 and 1971 under harsh high-alpine conditions, the dam is considered a landmark of European civil engineering. On a guided dam interior tour, visitors walk through the cool heart of this concrete giant: equipped with safety helmets, expert guides demonstrate the inner workings of massive inspection galleries, plumb-line measuring devices, and expansion joints that monitor structural movements seismographically 24/7. In recent years, the Schlegeis-Staumauer has also transformed into an internationally renowned outdoor action arena: thrillseekers fly across the abyss at dizzying heights right along the monumental concrete face on the 600-metre Flying Fox zip wire. Directly bolted into the vertical curve of the dam is the spectacular Klettersteig #Schlegeis131—the world's first via ferrata routed up a dam wall. Along the reservoir shoreline, gentle level paths invite relaxed strolls; more ambitious mountain hikers ascend in about 1.5 hours to the celebrated Olpererhütte, where the legendary suspension footbridge offers breathtaking views over the reservoir.

Visit & Arrival

The Schlegeis-Alpenstraße toll road and the dam grounds are open daily during the snow-free summer season from mid-May until late October (closed in winter). Dam interior tours operate daily every hour on the hour between 10:00 and 16:00. Toll fees for the Schlegeis-Alpenstraße (2025/2026 season): car approx. €17.00, motorcycle approx. €12.00. Dam tour: adults approx. €7.00, children (aged 6 to 15) approx. €4.00. Action tickets for the Flying Fox and via ferrata can be booked individually on site. Arriving by car: via the B169 to Mayrhofen, then branch off onto the toll-bearing Schlegeis-Alpenstraße through Ginzling and several natural rock tunnels up to the dam parking area. By public transport: Zillertalbahn train to Bahnhof Mayrhofen, where bus line 4102 operated by the Zillertaler Verkehrsbetriebe runs hourly directly to the dam.

Tips

The dam crest and the sun terraces of the Alpengasthaus Schlegeis are level and step-free for strollers and wheelchairs (the tour inside the dam involves climbing stairs and is not wheelchair-accessible). Inside the dam wall, temperatures remain at a constant 8 °C, making a warm jacket mandatory even in midsummer. Please allow plenty of time for the drive up the toll road, as certain narrow sections are controlled by one-lane traffic lights.
